title: How to change the Policy Exchange
lede: Publish new items, set the home page's big card, fix or remove what is live, and change the look.

slides.cap: Open Policy Exchange from the desk's front page.

notes.html: An item reaches the site only if ERC Newsletter only stays unticked. An A&M campus event comes ticked.

slides.cap: Only the Adding rows go to the site.

notes.html: A row that needs a fix names what is missing. Click those words to fix it in place.

slides.cap: Press Publish N to the Exchange, type the desk password, and press Confirm.

notes.html: Who has the password: READ ME FIRST - ERC handoff, in the shared drive.
Each publish files a copy of the site's list in the shared drive, in ERC Content Desk, Policy Exchange.

slides.cap: Open Highlight on the Policy Exchange page. It works any day, and publishing never changes the card.

notes.html: Cards made on the edit door with Add to New & Upcoming show here too, after the picks.
A Drive picture link never shows on the card. If the item has one, press Replace photo and choose a file.
An event or opportunity pick gets card words. The card shows them, and the photo, in place of the item's own.

slides.cap: In Pick from, press Highlight on a row, then give it a photo above. A blank Until becomes the event's date or the deadline, else two weeks.
Press Update the highlight, type the desk password, and press Confirm.

chapters.name: Fix or remove a live item

slides.cap: Publish only adds lines, so a desk edit to a live item stays on the desk. Fix the site on its own edit door, on a laptop.

notes.html: Who holds the Exchange's password: READ ME FIRST - ERC handoff, in the shared drive.

steps.title: Fix a live item
items: On the Policy Exchange page, open Edit live items. The site's sign-in opens in a new tab.
Type the Exchange's password, not the desk's, and press Sign in.
Press Edit on the item, fix it, and press Save.

slides.cap: The desk's Delete never touches the site. On the edit door, press Edit on the item, then hide it or delete it.

notes.html: Past events, closed opportunities and headlines over 60 days old leave by themselves.

steps.title: Hide it
items: Hide from the site takes it off the pages. It stays in the public news.csv.
Hidden items, in the top strip, lists it with Show again.

steps.title: Delete it
items: Undo works only while its note shows.

slides.cap: Logos, words and section names are code in the Exchange's GitHub repo. Open it in Claude Code and say what to change. A push to main is live in a minute.

steps.title: Where each part lives
items: Section names: NEWS_TABS in js/app.js, and the top bar of about/, newsletter/ and share/
